name: כַּלְכֹּל
summary: One of the wise men whom Solomon's wisdom surpassed, named with Ethan the Ezrahite, Heman and Darda, “the sons of Mahol” (1Ki 5:11); and Calcol among the sons of Zerah son of Judah, with Zimri, Ethan, Heman and Dara (1Ch 2:6). The name has the reduplicated shape of the pilpel כִּלְכֵּל “sustain, provide for” (Gen 47:12; 1Ki 5:7), so may mean “sustenance” or “one who sustains”; scripture does not explain it, and the reading rests on the form alone.

evidence.note: “He was wiser than all men, than Ethan the Ezrahite and Heman וְכַלְכֹּל and Darda, the sons of Mahol.”
“The sons of Zerah: Zimri and Ethan and Heman וְכַלְכֹּל and Dara, five in all.”
“וְכִלְכְּלוּ … king Solomon”: the pilpel the name's shape answers to.
Joseph “וַיְכַלְכֵּל his father and his brothers … with bread”.

note: Takes k.au.ab (2 tokens). TIPNR keeps two records (Calcol@1Ki.4.31, son of Mahol; Calcol@1Ch.2.6, son of Zerah); whether they are one man (the lists share Ethan, Heman and Darda/Dara) is not decided here, and both are named, as in heman.json. TIPNR's 1Ki.4.31 is 1Ki 5:11 in the Hebrew numbering. The tie to כול rests on the reduplicated form; no verse gives the meaning.
